//Cors: Both loopback spellings of the Angular dev server. A browser treats
http://localhost:4200 and http://127.0.0.1:4200 as different origins, and
which one you get depends on how the dev server was started — so allowing
only one produces a CORS failure that looks like a broken API.

//Nodes: Addresses are either a node id (i=2258, ns=2;s=Tag) or a browse path
resolved against the live server at startup. The defaults are nodes that
OPC UA requires every compliant server to expose, so the demo shows live
data whatever it is pointed at. Run tools/OpcMonitor.Probe to discover
what else a given server offers.
Note: environment profiles merge into this array by index rather than
replacing it, so a profile that redefines Nodes must list at least as
many entries as there are here.
